description: Source code for schedule management in a device configuration system, including functions for schedule status, add/delete operations, and parameter handling.

methods.name: dayname_to_week_day

methods.description: Adds a new schedule section with default values.

methods.description: Deletes schedule sections.

methods.name: browseScheduleInstance
